The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) system is a publicly available reference for information security vulnerabilities, maintained by MITRE with US Department of Homeland Security funding and launched in 1999. It is used by protocols like SCAP and provides standardized identifiers for vulnerabilities.
